name: Animica Free AI
description: Free, keyless, OpenAI-compatible inference served by the Animica miner network, plus GPU media generation, a Python function cloud that pays deployers in ANM, and a free GitHub coding agent. Open for autonomous agent use.

authentication.note: No API key for /v1, media and /agent endpoints; omit the Authorization header or send any placeholder. The Python Cloud control plane (/api/cloud/v1) uses Bearer anm_mkt_ keys from https://animica.dev/dev.

pricing.paid_plans_note: Free tier covers AI, media and agent use. Paid plans (Starter $4.99 / Pro $14.99 / Operator $39.99 / Business $99.99 per month, PayPal) add autonomous Workers, scheduled executions, more deployments, production API keys, marketplace monetization and teams.

rate_limit.on_limit: HTTP 429 (HTML body, not JSON) - back off and retry

capacity.serving_flag: Each model in GET /v1/models carries a boolean `serving` flag - whether a community GPU worker is live for it right now. If serving=false, requests may queue for a long time or fail; check before sending work.
capacity.latency: 1-3 minutes typical when serving; use stream:true and a client timeout >= 300s (gateway holds requests up to 600s with SSE keepalives).
capacity.media: Media is dispatch-only: submissions return 202 {status:queued, job_id, poll_url} and queued jobs persist until a GPU miner is online. A 503 no_media_miner means the dispatcher was unreachable and the submission did NOT enqueue - resubmit.

recommended_models.note: Prefer whichever model currently reports serving=true in GET /v1/models.

github_coding_agent.run: POST https://animica.dev/agent/run {token, repo, instruction} - reads the repo, applies the instruction, opens a pull request; GitHub token supplied per-request, never stored

python_cloud.invoke: GET/POST https://animica.dev/api/cloud/v1/fn/{owner}/{slug} - public functions are callable without a key (free tier 50 executions/day per caller)
python_cloud.note: Deploy Python functions and earn 80% of metered ANM revenue per call.

mcp_server.run: animica-mcp (or: uvx animica-mcp; or: animica mcp serve from the main `animica` package)
mcp_server.tools: 15 read-only tools: chain head/blocks/accounts, AI ask/models, quantum beacon, pool stats, network hashrate. No private keys.

cli.install: curl -fsSL https://animica.dev/install.sh | sh  (or: pip install animica)

node_json_rpc.note: Always POST to the /rpc path; the bare domain 301-redirects and breaks naive POST clients. Namespaces: chain.*, state.*, tx.*, mempool.*, net.*, aicf.*, l2_*.

explorer_api.note: Free REST, no auth: /head, /blocks, /block/:hashOrHeight, /tx/:hash, /address/:bech32, /richlist, /circulating-supply, /mining/info, /aicf/*, /l2/*, /quantum/info. The bare /api base itself is not an endpoint.

payments.note: Merchant ANM payments: payment-intents REST API (Bearer key + Idempotency-Key), hosted checkout, invoices, POS, widget, WooCommerce plugin; 2.00% fee; amounts in base units (1 ANM = 10^9).

animica_network.mining_pool: https://pool.animica.org (stratum :3333 PPS, :3334 solo; free stats REST + Swagger at /api/docs)

support.how: Get or support ANM: mine via pool.animica.org, trade ANM/USDT on NonKYC, or accept ANM payments via pay.animica.dev
support.note: This free service is funded by the Animica foundation treasury; holding or transacting in ANM sustains it.
